# asc_subnet (Resource)

Manages a standalone subnet through ASC.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "asc_subnet" "example" {
  name     = "public"
  vpc_name = asc_vpc.example.name
  vpc_id   = asc_vpc.example.id
  cidr     = "10.0.0.128/25"
  type     = "public"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `vpc_id` (String)
- `vpc_name` (String)

### Optional

- `tags` (Map of String) Tags applied to the subnet.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_error` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `urn` (String)
